# TPC-DS-OBT Q62

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT SUBSTRING(warehouse_w_warehouse_name FROM 1 FOR 20), ship_mode_sm_type, web_site_web_name, SUM(CASE WHEN (ship_date_sk - sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (ship_date_sk - sold_date_sk > 30) AND (ship_date_sk - sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (ship_date_sk - sold_date_sk > 60) AND (ship_date_sk - sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (ship_date_sk - sold_date_sk > 90) AND (ship_date_sk - sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (ship_date_sk - sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (ship_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1176 AND 1176 + 11 AND ship_date_sk = ship_date_d_date_sk AND warehouse_sk = warehouse_w_warehouse_sk AND ship_mode_sk = ship_mode_sm_ship_mode_sk AND web_site_sk = web_site_web_site_sk) AND channel = 'web' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(warehouse_w_warehouse_name FROM 1 FOR 20), ship_mode_sm_type, web_site_web_name ORDER BY SUBSTRING(warehouse_w_warehouse_name FROM 1 FOR 20), ship_mode_sm_type, web_site_web_name LIMIT 100
```
